correctness.rationale: Sign differences give a bijection up to initial letter; aa and abab correspond exactly to forbidden alternating sign triples. A valid inserted character forces a doubled opposite sign. Run-local forbidden-position accounting gives degree m+4 in one-run case, otherwise m+6-2r+t3; the run-composition GF, support, extrema, multiplicities follow. Direct insertion, sign-run and composition coefficient computations agree for n=3..12. Infinite theorem follows from explicit proof, not tests.

value.rationale: The exact number of eligible single-insertion outputs is a natural local error-neighborhood invariant for constrained string channels. The complete degree polynomial and sharp parity-sensitive extrema characterize strongly heterogeneous insertion branching for every block length, including a forbidden near-maximum degree. The result refines known word counts and is not merely finite enumeration or a routine codebook recomputation.
